why_vendored_not_imported: gmc_health.py runs on the MacBook watchdog host (its own docstring: 'the Gateway process runs on the Studio, not on this watchdog host'), while gmc_engine lives on the Studio. A PYTHONPATH import would be a cross-machine runtime dependency on a checkout this host may not have, and which self-refreshes from origin on its own schedule. The copy is byte-identical so divergence is detectable by hash rather than by reading.
sync_contract: test_scanner_mail_check.py recomputes this sha256 every run. It ALSO diffs against the upstream file when that path exists on the running host; when it does not, the test reports a NAMED cannot-verify state and does not pass silently.
